resources.string: Turn this phone into a camera. It keeps recording with the screen off and after a restart.
Watching a baby (alert me on sounds too)

Leave this off unless you need sound in the saved files. Android will not reliably give the microphone to the recorder and to the alerts at the same time, so turning it on can cost you the crying alerts and the Listen button.
Start again after the phone restarts
Recordings stay on this phone. Video is only sent while you are watching from the dashboard, so this uses almost no data when nothing is happening. Keep the phone on charge.
